chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Ali Majiluwayh (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-'Attar narrated to us from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya ibn 'Imran al-Ash'ari from al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Khashab from Ghiyath ibn Kulub from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (peace be upon them).

The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said: Instruct your dying to say 'there is no god but Allah' (la ilaha illallah), for whoever's last words are 'there is no god but Allah' will enter Paradise.

key_terms.تلقين: talqin — prompting the dying to recite the declaration of faith
key_terms.لا إله إلا الله: la ilaha illallah — there is no god but Allah, the declaration of divine oneness (tawhid)
key_terms.موتاكم: mawtakum — your dying ones, those at the point of death

ai.seo_question: What should be said to a dying person according to the Prophet Muhammad in Islam?
ai.summary: This prophetic hadith, transmitted through Imam al-Sadiq (AS) from the Prophet Muhammad (S), establishes the practice of talqin — prompting the dying person to recite the declaration of God's oneness (shahada). The hadith's context is the Shia funerary tradition, where talqin is performed both before and after death. The promise of Paradise for one who dies with these words on their lips underscores the centrality of tawhid (monotheism) as the fundamental article of faith in Islam.
